title: Invertibility of the normalized integral Tate quotient morphism
statement: For a Noetherian scheme T and a prime ell invertible on T, and n,d natural numbers, any morphism from realization T ell n of finiteSheaf T ell n d to quotientLine T ell n d satisfying GeneratorCompatible is an isomorphism.

source.place: Step 2: Invertibility of the normalized integral Tate quotient morphism

proof.text: Choose a common pro-etale cover with compatible primitive roots. Scalar coordinates identify the inverse-limit root module with the completed coefficient unit; after quotient and ordered tensor powers both source and target are free of rank one. GeneratorCompatible with scalar one sends basis to basis. The local inverses glue by uniqueness of inverse, giving an isomorphism. The empty tensor and empty scheme obey the same unit argument.
